text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I returned to Tracen Academy
after heading out with Tamamo Cross—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? A phone call...?
Sorry, hold on just a sec!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're the vendor I placed an order with!
...Wait, what!? What do you mean by that!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A problem with the stock... Can't we do something about it...!?
Don't ya have some old stock or somethin' similar!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's a present for my precious little brother!
Please, just check one more time...!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...My little brother won a running race the other day.
I was plannin' on givin' him that okonomiyaki cushion he wanted as a present."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, the vendor earlier mentioned...
There was some trouble, so they had to stop selling them.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I already told them I'd be home right away,
so I gotta do something about this...!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Tamamo Cross-san!
You forgot to hand in your assignment~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious!? At a time like this...!
Ugh, I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a clouded expression on her face,
Tamamo Cross walked away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there some way I can help—
As I racked my brain, words she had spoken in the past suddenly crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't have it, just make it!"
That's the ironclad rule in our house!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "This is it—having had that epiphany, I headed straight to Super Creek, who is skilled in sewing."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I see, so you want to make a handmade okonomiyaki cushion.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'd love to help out♪
I've been wanting to thank you for helping me during the ranch tour, after all~

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't have much experience with sewing either, but I will help as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, together with Super Creek and Oguri Cap, we began making an okonomiyaki cushion.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Does that mean, could it be—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Here it is, the okonomiyaki cushion
your little brother wanted~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That should solve the problem.
Good for you, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Did ya all go out of your way
to make this just for me...!?"
choice_data_list: It might look clumsy compared to the real thing, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! What are ya talkin' about?!
That's not it at all!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This cushion is packed full of yer love!
To me, it's worth way more than anything in a store...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'm so glad for you, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I've definitely felt your kindness and loyalty!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I thought rushing in 'cause I can't ignore someone in trouble was my specialty,
but... you and me are two of a kind, Trainer!
choice_data_list: It's my way of returning the favor for taking care of me.
Did it turn into a delicious-looking cushion?
Because I want to help Tamamo too!
Because I want to help Tamamo too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I thought rushing in 'cause I can't ignore someone in trouble was my specialty,
but... you and me are two of a kind, Trainer!
choice_data_list: It's my way of returning the favor for taking care of me.
Did it turn into a delicious-looking cushion?
Because I want to help Tamamo too!
Because I want to help Tamamo too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's true♪ Tama-chan is
always helping me out, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then it's my turn next!
I always make sure to return any favor double-fold!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see. Then I will have to repay that kindness once again.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, no! Leave that alone!
We'll never finish at this rate!"
choice_data_list: I think it'd be good if we just helped each other out.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Kindness begets kindness...
It truly is a wonderful thing, isn't it? ♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I want to keep having this kind of relationship with Tama-chan from here on out, too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Me too.
How about you, Tama?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Lookin' at me with those sparkly eyes,
how am I supposed to say no...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Got it, got it! It's all give and take,
so let's keep having each other's backs!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Good grief, I just can't keep up with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through this whole ordeal, I felt as though
I built a stronger bond of trust with Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah,
no matter how ya look at it, that's one fine okonomiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrr~)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I'm hungry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, what adorable sounds coming from both the Trainer's
and Oguri-chan's tummies♪
choice_data_list: I've been sewing for quite a long time, after all…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha!
If that's the case, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
To thank ya for the cushion,
I'll treat ya to some okonomiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I've honed my skills even more since our last okonomiyaki party! I'll show off the fruits of my training in grand style!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, everyone thoroughly enjoyed the okonomiyaki that Tamamo Cross treated us to.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what's this,
you're really bitin' at the bit, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "That just goes to show how much I'm thinking about you, Tama-chan~♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan is such a good girl,
but she often tries to take everything on all by herself, so—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"We want you to rely on us and Trainer every once in a while.
Right?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Creek...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Besides, when someone's a cute girl working her hardest,
you just want to pamper her with all you've got, don't you? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Uggh... I appreciate the thought,
but I'll pass on being treated like a kid, ya hear?
choice_data_list: It's not treating you like a kid, it's about duty and humanity!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so. In that case...
I'm not used to it, but... this kinda thing ain't half bad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Tamamo Cross smile bashfully, I felt a warmth spread through my chest.
